_note: Declared properties of every camera in the MFSTNet corpus (P58).
P45's density gate and P17's unassigned-rate gate are both correct and
neither asks what a camera IS. That is how the M6 Motorway — a British
divided carriageway with enforced lane discipline — became 41% of the
evaluation corpus and 53% of every HIGH label in a project about
Nothing here can be inferred from a filename with confidence, so every
entry records HOW it was determined. 'frame' means the footage was looked
at; 'filename' means it was not, and those entries are provisional.
`target_domain` is what the PRD claims the project is about.
scripts/audit_corpus.py checks the evaluation against it and FAILS when no
fold-eligible camera matches, because a paper cannot claim a domain its

`licence` is recorded per camera because the releasable claim in docs/00-planning/CLAIMS.yaml depends on it. Every entry is currently unresolved: the corpus is built from third-party YouTube uploads, and nothing derived from them is releasable until that is settled.

target_domain.note: PRD §1: unstructured Indian traffic, camera-only, elevated view.

M6 Motorway Traffic.note: Divided motorway, enforced lane discipline, no junction, no mixed traffic, no pedestrians. The premise's counterexample.

Incredible traffic Sound in Dhaka, Bangl.note: Footbridge over a junction. Rickshaws, auto-rickshaws, motorcycles, pedestrians in the carriageway.

🎧 Incredible traffic Sound in Dhaka, Ban.note: Footbridge over a divided boulevard past South Point School. A DIFFERENT scene from the clip above despite the near-identical title; correlated by city, corridor and uploader.

Pov_Thursday Traffic From Footover bridg.note: 'Pov' is misleading — this is a pedestrian footover bridge, not a dashcam. BSRM and Salam Steel signage.

Mumbai Traffic Chaos - Near Andheri Stat.note: PROVISIONAL — frames not inspected. Only 6 lane-windows, below ADR-019 eligibility.

South Extension traffic multi-coloured_.note: PROVISIONAL — frames not inspected. Only 3 lane-windows, below ADR-019 eligibility.
